info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Languages API

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale of the requested consent language. An optional field, if not passed then en-US will be used.

params.name: consent_types
params.description:
List of Consent Type for different services. An optional query parameter, if not provided then all type of consent languages will be returned in the response
Possible values are INDIA_FRICTIONLESS, DEVICE_AUTH and FRICTIONLESS_DEVICE_AUTH
Multiple values can be sent in the request in order to receive multiple consents in response.

items.docs: Get the consent language text for enrolled service(s). A merchant/psp can use this API to get the text for their enrollment and cache it for later use.
